title: Make the meeting review actionable from the human inbox and readable after refresh

incident.stored_synthesis: Synthesis empty or unreadable; recorded as REVIEW with no proposal.

changes.src/lib/bff-v1/meetings.ts: Added reviewMeeting(meetingId, { note }, idempotencyKey) calling POST /bff/management/meetings/{id}/review with write-gate check, 1..2000 Unicode character validation, Idempotency-Key header, and Human Inbox cache invalidation + V5 event emission on save; normalized operator_review (status, disposition='closed_no_proposal', note, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, cause), unreadable_reason/synthesis_unreadable_reason (fallback 'unknown' on legacy REVIEW rows), and visible evidence_refs (stripping withheld private memory item IDs and citations); added buildFollowUpConveneInput(detail) to reuse conveneMeeting with source meeting context.
changes.src/lib/v5/management/humanInbox.ts: Added optional meetingId/meetingType/unreadableReason/cause fields to HumanInboxItem and helpers meetingIdFromInboxItem, meetingReviewHrefFromInboxItem, and meetingTypeFromInboxItem.
changes.src/management/pages/meetings/MeetingDet: Added Meeting Synthesis Review & Operator Disposition card for REVIEW meetings showing localized blocking reason (synthesis_review_required), localized review cause ('unknown' legacy explanation vs specific stored cause), available deliberation transcript (rounds & positions) and shared case-file facts alongside the reason, accurate evidence citations or explicit empty-citation notice, a separate follow-up research convene path (Meetings Center convene link + explicit operator convene button using buildFollowUpConveneInput/conveneMeeting, never automatic on page load), pre-submission consequence callout, review note textarea + submit button with accidental-resubmit protection and truthful backend error reporting, persisted operator_review readback (note, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, closed_no_proposal) across refresh while keeping original REVIEW synthesis/outcome/0 proposals intact, and read-only inspection without write controls for read-only users.
changes.src/management/pages/oversight/HumanGate: Localized machine blocking reason codes (synthesis_review_required, etc.) with secondary raw code while preserving free-text blocking reasons; enriched meeting_review inbox detail with getMeetingDetail readback, localized cause explanation, transcript/case-file stats, accurate meeting evidence refs (or accurate empty-evidence explanation), direct link to /management/meetings/{id} and follow-up convene flow, and actionable meeting review disposition form / persisted review display / read-only notice.
changes.src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts: Added enumLabels.reasons for synthesis_review_required, unknown, closed_no_proposal, model_output_missing, synthesis_empty, synthesis_unreadable, invalid_json, more_research_requested, review_note_required, review_note_too_long, meeting_already_reviewed, meeting_not_in_review, insufficient_role, operator_required, plus meetingsCenter.detail.review and mgmt.inbox meeting review strings.
changes.src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts: Added matching English translations in parity with zh-TW.ts.

hosted_browser_acceptance_steps_for_coor: 1. Pre-check release identity: Verify https://app.dev.mvl-cap.tw/deployment.json serves an accepted pair containing Pantheon BFF >= 20ad89fe3cddc6c1426ea3b139a9de3c94a1fc7c and this execute-plans commit.

2. Read-only inspection of the reported legacy item (DO NOT mutate mtg-2c016da5651a0dc4 during verification): Open https://app.dev.mvl-cap.tw/management/human-inbox and locate card meeting_review:mtg-2c016da5651a0dc4 (澄川 MT-1). Click '開啟詳情' / 'Open detail' (/management/human-inbox/meeting_review%3Amtg-2c016da5651a0dc4) and verify: (a) the blocking reason is localized ('會議綜合結論為待人工審查（REVIEW，零提案），需操作員審核處置 (synthesis_review_required)' in zh-TW and 'Meeting synthesis ended in REVIEW with no proposal and requires operator review disposition (synthesis_review_required)' in en-US); (b) the cause section accurately explains that this legacy record did not store a detailed machine cause code (cause: unknown); (c) visible evidence citations from the meeting case file/rounds are shown (or accurate empty-citation notice if none); (d) click '前往會議審核頁' / 'Open meeting review' (or '開啟處理頁' / 'Open action page') to navigate directly to /management/meetings/mtg-2c016da5651a0dc4.

3. Verify MeetingDetailPage explanation and separate follow-up convene path on /management/meetings/mtg-2c016da5651a0dc4: Confirm the Meeting Synthesis Review & Operator Disposition card renders above the rounds with: (a) the legacy unknown-cause explanation alongside the stored synthesis summary ('Synthesis empty or unreadable; recorded as REVIEW with no proposal.') and the 2-round deliberation transcript summary where participants requested more research; (b) the separate '需要更多研究？以本場會議脈絡另行召開會議' / 'Need More Research? Convene a Follow-Up Meeting with Source Context' section linking to /management/meetings?tab=upcoming&type=MT-1&persona_id=persona-2448c7053e33ea48da47&source_meeting_id=mtg-2c016da5651a0dc4; (c) no automatic POST /review or POST /meetings firing on page load (Network tab shows GET requests only).

4. Read-only role check: While logged in as the viewer principal (or on the read-only deployment profile), open /management/meetings/mtg-2c016da5651a0dc4 and /management/human-inbox/meeting_review%3Amtg-2c016da5651a0dc4. Confirm the explanation, cause, rounds, case-file items, and evidence refs are readable while write controls (review note textarea, close-review submit button, and inline follow-up convene button) are hidden and the read-only notice is shown.

5. Action and reload verification on an isolated nonfinancial record: Using the isolated dev acceptance fixture meeting (mtg-dev-acceptance-review-disposition-20261121, or an isolated nonfinancial closed REVIEW test meeting) as an authenticated operator with governed writes enabled: (a) open /management/meetings/<isolated_meeting_id>; (b) verify the pre-submission consequence banner states that submitting closes the review as closed_no_proposal, removes meeting_review:<isolated_meeting_id> from the pending Human Inbox, and preserves the original REVIEW outcome, synthesis, transcript, and 0 proposals; (c) enter a review note and click '記錄審核並以無提案結案' / 'Close Review with No Proposal'; (d) verify POST /bff/management/meetings/<isolated_meeting_id>/review returns 200 OK and the form immediately transitions to the persisted review card showing note, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, and disposition closed_no_proposal with no submit button remaining; (e) reload the browser page (F5) and confirm GET /bff/management/meetings/<isolated_meeting_id> still renders the persisted note, reviewer, and timestamp while Chair Synthesis still shows Outcome: REVIEW and Proposals shows 0 proposals; (f) navigate back to /management/human-inbox and confirm meeting_review:<isolated_meeting_id> is no longer in the pending queue.
